id.label: id
id.help: Items and other categories name the category by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

name.label: name
name.help: The title in the item browser. Unset: the id.

icon.label: icon
icon.help: The item shown for the category. Unset: minecraft:stone.

priority.label: priority
priority.help: Lower values come first; equal ones are sorted by id. Default: 0.

hidden.label: hidden
hidden.help: Leaves the category off the main page, e.g. one only opened from another category.

source.label: source
source.help: Where the members come from. Several sources are appended in order.

id.label: id
id.help: Saplings and placed features name the feature by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

type.label: type
type.help: The vanilla feature type, or craftengine:simple_block for a custom block.

config.label: config
config.help: The feature's settings as YAML, e.g. from misode's configured feature generator. Custom block ids work wherever vanilla ones do; craftengine:simple_state_provider and the other craftengine: providers help where vanilla ones do not.

id.label: id
id.help: Grass blocks name the feature by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

feature.label: feature
feature.help: The configured feature to place: its id, or one written here.

placement.label: placement
placement.help: The placement modifiers as a YAML list, e.g. rarity_filter, in_square, heightmap. A biome filter needs - type: minecraft:biome here.

world.label: world
world.help: Only these worlds, by their exact name. Unset: all.

dimensionType.label: dimension_type
dimensionType.help: Only dimensions of these types. Unset: all.

biome.label: biome
biome.help: Only these biomes. Needs the minecraft:biome modifier in the placement.

id.label: id
id.help: The atlas the sources go into, e.g. minecraft:blocks. Entries with the same id are merged.

sources.label: sources
sources.help: Where the atlas's sprites come from.

enable.label: enable
enable.help: Off: CraftEngine skips the whole pack.

subpacks.label: subpacks
subpacks.help: Folders of the pack loaded as packs of their own when true. A key like $$>=1.21.4 turns a group on only for those server versions.

id.label: id
id.help: Names the section config_factory#id; letters, digits and _ . -.

blueprint.label: blueprint
blueprint.help: Config sections (items, recipes, …) with $'{'argument'}' placeholders, read once per instance.

instances.label: instances
instances.help: A YAML list of argument maps, one per copy, e.g. - color: white. An argument can be a typed template argument.

path.label: path
path.help: The file below the pack's script folder, without .js. Functions and conditions name it as namespace:path.

source.label: source
source.help: JavaScript. //@Subscribe, //@Task, //@Enable and //@Disable above a function register it.

list.label: list
list.help: Item ids and #category references, in this order.

list.label: list
list.help: An item id, or a category id with # in front to nest it.

regex.label: regex
regex.help: Every item (vanilla too) whose full id matches.

regex.label: regex
regex.help: One or more regular expressions over the whole item id.

ignoreVanilla.label: ignore_vanilla
ignoreVanilla.help: Keeps only custom items. Default: on.

directory.label: directory
directory.help: Every texture in a folder and its subfolders.

prefix.label: prefix
prefix.help: Put in front of every sprite id.

sprite.label: sprite
sprite.help: The sprite id. Unset: the texture id.

filter.label: filter
filter.help: Removes the sprites whose namespace or path matches.

pattern.label: pattern
pattern.help: Regular expressions; set at least one.

unstitch.label: unstitch
unstitch.help: Cuts regions of one texture into sprites of their own.

divisorX.label: divisor_x
divisorX.help: The width the region coordinates refer to. Default: 1.

divisorY.label: divisor_y
divisorY.help: The height the region coordinates refer to. Default: 1.

palettedPermutations.label: paletted_permutations
palettedPermutations.help: Recoloured copies of textures, one per palette.

separator.label: separator
separator.help: Joins texture name and suffix. Default: _.

category.label: Category
category.description: Adds the item to categories of the /ce item browser, after their own members.

overrides.label: Overrides
overrides.description: Keys that replace the template's keys as a whole (no merging), e.g. a list the template sets.

merges.label: Merges
merges.description: Keys deep-merged into the template's result, after its arguments are filled in.
